scope: Four new-build raw Transformer L3 baseline screenshots only; all actually opened with view_image after before-hash snapshot.
reviewer: Codex subagent /root/boundary_matrix_pixel_audit; automated actual-pixel review, not human researcher or publication reviewer

environmentScope.screenshots: Every reviewed raw image is 1280 x 720; current DOM viewport individually cross-checked.
environmentScope.userAgent: Earlier same selected IAB observation, as explicitly marked in per-case environmentProvenance; current UA remains unobserved.
environmentScope.currentEnvironmentFile: Not used to generalize its earlier 1102 x 835 state across captures.

limitations: Raw screenshots were actually opened and visually inspected; no pass inferred from helper/status/metadata.
Pixel inspection supports visible contour, selected controls, clipping/modal absence and style, not canonical endpoint or shared/repeat correctness.
Deep-fit tiny labels cannot establish per-node/port/legend readability at publication size.
Physical 85/180 mm readability, real human acceptance, export paint fidelity and presented performance are unverified.
Hash stability links the files reviewed; it does not independently certify screenshot provenance.

cases.method: tools.view_image once for this exact raw screenshot, at original 1280 by 720 native-file size; AI pixel review, not human participant review

pixelObservations.visibleModelTitle: Transformer in app bar; matching miniature paper-title area
pixelObservations.frontierContour: Tall narrow full paper, approximately 130 pixels across; deeply expanded two stacked encoder regions at left and decoder stack at right, long routed outer connections. Sidebar clearly shows EncoderLayer 2 and an expanded feedforward subtree (expand, activation, dropout, project). Small legend strip visible inside paper bottom.
pixelObservations.previewStyle: White boxes with dark outlines and grayscale routes.
pixelObservations.textReadability: Deep-fit sheet labels, ports and legend text are too small to reliably read. Exact expansion identities/node counts/endpoint meanings are not certified by these pixels.

cases.result: Visible contour, width/preset header and full-paper/legend framing consistent with named deep baseline case; no obstructing modal. Fine readability remains unverified.
